name: Ice by Post
tagline: Ice, delivered to your door. We can't promise it'll still be frozen.
summary: A box of 24 clear ice cubes in a wool-insulated box with gel packs. £16. It may arrive partly or fully melted.
concept: Clear ice, trimmed and packed in a wool-lined box with gel packs, sent Cold, arriving the next day. It is ice, in the post, so it may not stay ice.
why_it_exists: Good clear ice is hard to make at home. We make it and post it. We can't promise it'll still be frozen when it arrives.
target_customer: People hosting drinks who want clear ice and accept the risk of the post.

physical.form: 24 clear ice cubes, each individually trimmed, packed in a wool-lined box with gel packs.
materials: Ice made from filtered water, frozen directionally
physical.weight: Ice about 1.2 kg. Box about 2.4 kg packed.

features: It is clear ice made from filtered water, so it looks good in a glass.
You get 24 cubes, each one 30 mm across and trimmed to size.
It travels in a wool-lined box with gel packs, so there is no dry ice and nothing dangerous in the parcel.
It is sent cold and arrives the next day before 1pm.
It may not arrive frozen, and we say so before you buy.
arrives: The ice is sealed in a food bag inside a wool-lined box with gel packs, then packed in a card outer box. It travels as its own cold parcel. When it lands, open it straight away and put whatever is still frozen into your freezer.
specs: Ice about 1.2 kg. Box about 2.4 kg packed.
Filtered-water ice, wool-fleece lining, gel packs, corrugated card box
Clear ice, off-white box with lilac gel packs
24 clear cubes, 30 mm each, about 50 g each
Wool insulation and gel packs. No dry ice.
Freeze at -18°C or below as soon as it arrives, if it is still ice
Cold, next day before 1pm. It may arrive partly or fully melted.
how_it_works: We freeze and pack the ice, and send it Monday to Thursday. Open the box when it arrives and put what is still frozen in the freezer.
in_the_box: 24 clear ice cubes in a sealed bag
A wool-lined box with gel packs

compatibility.note: Both travel chilled. In a mixed order they arrive in two parcels and one chilled delivery charge is paid.
No dry ice is used or sent. Do not add it to the box.
The Starter Puddle is a tray for rain, not ice.

packaging: Ice is sealed in a food-grade bag inside a wool-lined box with gel packs, in a corrugated card outer. The card and wool are recyclable where local rules allow. Gel packs can be emptied into the bin.

warranty.summary: It has no warranty and no frozen guarantee, because it is food.

care: Open the box when it arrives and check the ice.
Put anything still frozen into a freezer at -18°C or below.
Use clear ice in drinks within a few days of arrival.
Recycle the box. Empty the gel packs into the bin.
safety: Do not use it if the bag is open or torn.
Do not use ice that has been left out for a long time.
The cubes are hard and cold. Handle with care.

delivery.note: Cold only, sent Monday to Thursday. It arrives the next day before 1pm. We hold the order when the forecast at your address is 28°C or above, and offer a new date or a refund.

returnable.note: Ice cannot be returned, because it is perishable. If it arrives melted, that is the product. If the parcel is wrong or damaged, contact support within 24 hours with a photo.

sections.title: Clear ice
sections.body: A box of 24 clear cubes, 30 mm each, for £16.

sections.title: How it travels
sections.body: It goes in wool and gel packs, with no dry ice. It is sent Cold, Monday to Thursday.

sections.title: The catch
sections.body: It is ice in the post, so it may arrive partly or fully melted. We hold the order in hot weather.

faq.a: We can't promise it. It is ice in the post.
That is the product. We do not refund melted ice, and it cannot be returned.
Cold only. It is sent Monday to Thursday.
If the forecast at your address is 28°C or above, we hold the order and offer a new date or a refund.
No. Only wool and gel packs.

faq.q: Can I order it with other things?
faq.a: Yes. It travels as its own parcel, so you get two parcels and pay one delivery charge.

steps: Put what is left in the freezer at once.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Melting is not a fault. Refrozen ice may be cloudy.

troubleshooting.problem: The box is damaged or the item is wrong.
steps: Photograph the box and the label.
Check whether your order came in two parcels.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Contact support within 24 hours of delivery with the photo.

troubleshooting.problem: My order is on hold for hot weather.
steps: Check the forecast for your address.
Pick a new date when we offer one.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: You can take a refund instead.
